about: Solid colliders of the vanilla pieces in their own frame (from data/piece-models.json, lab/build_models.js): oriented boxes {c, s, q}, spheres {t: sph, c, r}, capsules {t: cap, c, r, h, ax}; m: 1 marks a box standing for a mesh collider. pass: 1 means nothing solid (rugs, cloth, food, plants). Read by lib/shapes.js.
